# Notes for the Requirements phase

The learner writes SH-5, the one story the backlog leaves out, as a story
record: who wants it, what they want and why, its acceptance criteria and
what it leaves out. The four settled stories are the phase's provided stories,
and the learner reads them but cannot change them.

The checks are the story floor: the full As a, I want, so that sentence, at
least two criteria, a happy-path and a boundary criterion, and at least one
thing left out of scope. The AI reviewer marks the rest against the rubric.

The file `interview.json` holds the missing story as the stakeholder would
tell it. No phase mounts it, so a learner never opens it, but it is not a
comment: LearnSDLC seals it as the stakeholder interview, and its persona
names who the learner talks to. The AI interviewer answers from its facts,
and the AI reviewer is given them when it marks the story, because the task
brief names that stakeholder in the same words and the same capitals.

Put only the missing story in the interview. A story the backlog already
shows wastes the interview's places, and a fact copied into text the learner
can read gives the answer away.
